originalPaperLinkOnly.citation: Spitzer RL, Kroenke K, Williams JBW, Löwe B. A Brief Measure for Assessing Generalized Anxiety Disorder: The GAD-7. Archives of Internal Medicine. 2006;166(10):1092–1097.
originalPaperLinkOnly.access_note: Six-page publisher article openly readable from University of Washington; Figure 1 p.1094 confirms original seven symptoms and extra unscored difficulty question. Freely readable is not an open redistribution license.
originalPaperLinkOnly.article_reuse_status: LINK_ONLY: PDF explicitly says ©2006 American Medical Association, all rights reserved; no article PDF copied.
originalPaperLinkOnly.evidence_summary: US study across 15 primary-care clinics; adult participants 18–95 years. Abstract reports 2,740, body 2,739 with no/minimal missing data; preserve this source discrepancy. Criterion interviews: 965. Threshold >=10 had sensitivity 89%, specificity 82% for GAD. Original severity tables: 0–4 minimal,5–9 mild,10–14 moderate,15–21 severe. Two-week symptom window does not establish diagnostic duration; original reference interview used six months.
